chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was asked about fasting on two Thursdays with a Wednesday between them, so he said: As for Thursday, it is a day on which deeds are presented; as for Wednesday, it is a day on which the Fire was created; and as for fasting, it is a shield.

key_terms.الْأَرْبِعَاءُ: Wednesday; identified here as the day on which the Fire was created
key_terms.الْأَعْمَالُ: deeds; the acts of human beings presented before Allah
key_terms.الْخَمِيسُ: Thursday; identified here as a day when deeds are presented
key_terms.صَوْمِ: fasting; abstaining in worship for the sake of Allah
key_terms.فَجُنَّةٌ: a shield; a protection and defense

ai.seo_question: Why is it recommended to fast two Thursdays with a Wednesday between them?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the merit of fasting on specific days, especially Thursdays and the Wednesday between them. It links Thursday to the presentation of deeds, Wednesday to the creation of the Fire, and describes fasting generally as a protection and shield.
